snippet.title: Time To Wake Up - PS5 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Time To Wake Up is a new psychological horror thriller coming to PS5 on October 12, 2026.

You're stuck in a dream. Blink to change your surroundings and escape the shadows of your past.

Wishlist it now on the PlayStation Store:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019341
